a novel method to control release rate of corrosion inhibitors by the Ca2+ treated halloysite encapsulating Na2MoO 4 with the end stopper of CaMoO 4 is proposed.

the development of smart materials and the design of new corrosion inhibitor, which can provide new ideas for the development of smart corrosion protection coatings.

the development of a novel corrosion inhibitor based on halloysite nanocage and the Ca2+ end stopper, which can not only provide a high corrosion resistance but also a sustained release of corrosion inhibitor in the epoxy coating.
the development of a new class of smart corrosion inhibitors, which can provide the highest protection for steel under acidic conditions.
